dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, thick white and black bands visible across the upper wing coverts and edges.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp white spots and pale edges creating high-contrast boundaries along the dark flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast, dark sub-rectangular patch is clearly visible on the nape/upper mantle region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct, linear boundary separating the lighter nape area from the dark patch on the upper back.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized rufous (reddish-brown) patch is visible on the lower left flank near the base of the tail.
